anchor.comment: I love the colours of everythiung, especially the progress bar on option 1, but I also like the sleek animations of spectral line, can we combine these somehow?
anchor.reply: Five new candidates, each one way of making the film's turn and the spectral line one thing: the line lays the film down, turning (recommended); the line scans the edge round; two wavelengths meet in the middle; the slit stands and the film turns under it; the line sweeps, then the film turns. Every candidate keeps round one's progress bar exactly (the film fill whose colour turns as it fills) and adds the line to it.
